steps.caption: The planted branch renames ThreadResolved to ThreadClosed, and every test passes.
review.sh diffs the branch against cp-02 and skips the lockfile and snapshots.
The glossary goes into the prompt before the diff does.
A model other than the author's reads it, and REVIEWER picks claude or pi.
The review names ThreadClosed and verdict as defects and asks one question.
